02 / UNDER THE HOOD

Inspectable by design

Useful AI needs
more than a prompt.

Evidence Lab makes the retrieval layer visible. Change the corpus, inspect a result, or run the evaluation. The behavior is yours to test.

01

Ingest & chunk

PDF, text, and Markdown become overlapping word windows. Each chunk keeps its document name and PDF page number.

document → source chunks
02

Retrieve & rank

BM25 ranks chunks by query terms. Adjustable chunk sizes and retrieval depth let you explore the tradeoffs.

query → ranked evidence
03

Cite & inspect

Source excerpts link back to their context. Unsupported queries return an explicit no-evidence response.

evidence → traceable excerpts
ENGINEERING NOTE

Lexical retrieval is fast, private, and free to run. It can miss synonyms and does not reason across sources. A production generative RAG system would add semantic retrieval, a model, and answer-quality evaluation.
